# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 20 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 20
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. It is therefore well that a man who has learned the righteous ordinances of the Lord, as many as have been written, should walk in them. For the one who does these things will be glorified in the kingdom of God; and the one who chooses the other things will perish together with his works.
2. For this reason there is a resurrection; for this reason there is a recompense.
3. I ask those who are in a higher position — if you receive any counsel of good advice — do not put away from yourselves any one of you, but love all the more, and strive even more for their salvation.
